name: Crown of Convergence
description: A delicate golden crown radiating white light that Miri's mother gives her to present as a prize from Vitu-Ghazi.

timeline.summary: Miri's mother secretly gives her the Crown of Convergence to give her father in place of the vulnerability, and Miri gives it to him.
timeline.quote: The Crown of Convergence? Miri, this is worth thousands!
